title: Numbers 11 to 20
short: Read and write the teen numbers and 20.
trouble: Children write teen numbers in the order they hear them, so "fourteen" becomes 41.

blocks.html: After 10 come the teen numbers. You have counted to 20. Now let’s read and write them.

blocks.name: tenframe
blocks.cap: 14 is a full ten frame and 4 more.

blocks.html: A teen number starts with 1, for one ten. The second digit tells how many more.
We write the ten first, on the left, and the extra ones next. That is why fourteen is written 14, even though we say “four” first.

blocks.title: Writing fourteen
steps: Fourteen is ten and four more.

blocks.html: Writing 41 for fourteen, because “four” is heard first. 41 is a much bigger number! A teen number always starts with 1.
For grown-ups: Point out teen numbers on clocks, calendars and house numbers. Ask: “Is that ten and how many more?”
